entities.summary: Christian Dvorak is an American professional ice hockey player who is a center for the Philadelphia Flyers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the second round, 58th overall, by the Arizona Coyotes in the 2014 NHL entry draft. Dvorak has also previously played for the Montreal Canadiens.
